# Paypr

> Paypr is an iPhone app that tracks hours and pay for the people you hire by the hour — nanny, babysitter, tutor, house cleaner or housekeeper — and keeps a running balance of what you owe. It also has a contractor view for people who are *paid* by the hour and need to track hours across multiple clients. Records stay on the user's device and sync through their own private iCloud account.

Paypr is made by QAtion. It is **not** a payroll service: it does not withhold taxes, file forms or move money. It is the record layer — hours worked, rate, payments made, running balance, CSV export — that payroll filing and tax time depend on.

## What Paypr does

- **Log hours in seconds.** Drag across a day timeline or tap a quick entry. No timesheet formatting, no formulas.
- **Always-current balance.** Set each person's hourly rate once; the amount owed updates as hours are logged.
- **Settle up.** Mark payments paid in full or in part; the balance carries the remainder forward.
- **Per-person history.** Separate records for every nanny, sitter, tutor or cleaner.
- **Overtime-aware math.** Weekly totals make it obvious when someone passed 40 hours.
- **CSV export (Pro).** Clean year-end records of hours and payments per person, for Schedule H, a W-2, or an accountant.
- **Contractor view.** Clock in as you work, see what each client owes you, and share a statement of unpaid hours.
- **Private by design.** Data lives on the device and syncs via the user's own iCloud. No ads, no data selling; analytics never include names, amounts or balances.

## Pricing

- Free forever — track 1 person.
- Paypr Pro — $2.99/month after a 7-day free trial, or $7.99 once for lifetime. Unlocks unlimited people, weekly/monthly/yearly summaries and CSV export.

## Platform

iPhone, iOS 17.0 or later. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/paypr/id6778970494

## Questions Paypr answers directly

- [Easiest way to track a part-time nanny's hours without a spreadsheet](https://usepaypr.com/nanny-hours-tracker-vs-spreadsheet): why spreadsheets break for variable household hours, and the four fields you actually need.
- [How to calculate and track nanny overtime](https://usepaypr.com/how-to-calculate-nanny-overtime): nannies are non-exempt under the FLSA — 1.5× the regular rate over 40 hours in a workweek, with live-in and state exceptions.
- [How to keep records of payments to a house cleaner for tax purposes](https://usepaypr.com/house-cleaner-payment-records): employee vs self-employed cleaner, why households generally don't issue a 1099-NEC, and what to keep.
- [Best apps for household payroll for babysitters and tutors](https://usepaypr.com/best-household-payroll-apps): honest comparison of full-service payroll, tracker apps and spreadsheets, and which one a given household actually needs.
- [Nanny payroll service vs. an hours tracker](https://usepaypr.com/paypr-vs-nanny-payroll-services): what each category does, what it costs, and when you need both.
- [Private hours tracking across multiple clients](https://usepaypr.com/contractor-hours-tracker): the contractor side of Paypr.
